profile.title: COLLECTED
profile.text: Backend-focused developer obsessed with systems, infrastructure, performance, and browser-native tech.
profile.summary: I build TypeScript & Node.js applications, APIs, relational-database-heavy systems, and real-time features. Practical experience with WebSockets, WebRTC, REST APIs, and deployment through CI/CD, containers, Linux servers, and distributed serverless services. I design modular software focused on robustness and resource utilization, inspired by the Unix philosophy.

experience.title: Experience
experience.intro: Deployment logs from live systems I helped ship, secure, or automate.

points: Eliminated server-side asset inference and storage by generating assets on-demand on the client — cut associated inference and storage usage by 100%
Built an internal static code-generation pipeline for the asset-generation workflow; audited internal APIs and fixed security issues across 118 endpoints
Configured Supabase services for offline deployments and designed an offline-online data synchronization engine for event operations

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: Selected builds where I explored browser-native tech, local AI orchestration, and performance-first web systems.

items.title: Cloud Workspace
items.desc: Collaborative cloud workspace with real-time messaging, shared tasks, file/image uploads, scheduled meetings, and peer-to-peer video calls. Chat runs on WebSockets with Cloudflare Durable Objects for stateful coordination; role-based access via Better Auth.

items.title: Live Token Meter
items.desc: OpenCode plugin that tracks live token generation rate, tokens from the last response, total session output, and per-turn usage in real time through the v2 API.

items.title: SQL Visualizer
items.desc: SPA that parses SQL schema definitions and renders relational schemas as an interactive architecture graph — tables laid out with their foreign-key relationships.

items.title: Multi-Tenant SSO Service
items.desc: Single Sign-On service providing centralized sign-in and authorization across multiple applications. Implements authentication flows, tenant isolation, and security controls on API routes.

items.title: WASM Video Editor
items.desc: Browser-based video processing with WebAssembly and FFmpeg. Real-time encoding, decoding, and export pipelines — desktop-grade media processing inside the browser with zero server compute.

items.title: Local LLM Interface
items.desc: Streaming chat interface for locally-hosted AI models. Backend APIs manage model lifecycle — load, unload, swap — reducing cold-start latency and improving runtime orchestration.

items.title: Personal Blog Platform
items.desc: SEO-optimized static site built with Next.js and MDX. Server-side rendering and edge caching deliver sub-200ms page loads on Vercel's edge network.

items.title: Dotfiles & Dev Environment
items.desc: Terminal-first Linux workflow configured with Neovim, tmux, fish, and Lazygit. Fedora-based daily driver tuned for backend and systems work.

stack.title: Stack
stack.intro: Technologies I use to design, deploy, and operate systems from the terminal to the edge.

research.title: Research
research.intro: Deep dives into production codebases to understand how real systems are architected, documented, and shipped.
research.body: Analyzed the real production codebase behind react.dev to map architecture decisions: custom MDX components, a build-time SSG pipeline, and the React Compiler already running in production.
points: No state management library needed — URL + useState + Context sufficient
50+ custom MDX components behind each doc page
Custom SSG pipeline that serializes React tree to JSON at build time
Build-time eval() workarounds acknowledged as intentional hacks
